build_EQATask: build a python module to run an embodied question answering task using the EQATask class
create_EQAEpisode: create an EQAEpisode with a QuestionData object containing question text and answer text
use_QuestionSensor: use the QuestionSensor class to observe question tokens from an EQAEpisode during simulation
test_AnswerAccuracy: test the AnswerAccuracy measure to verify if the agent's answer matches the correct answer token
run_AnswerAction: run the AnswerAction to submit an answer_id and complete an embodied question answering episode
